title: Illinois REAL ID requirements
facts: A first-time Illinois REAL ID applicant generally needs one document from identity/date-of-birth/lawful-status requirements, proof of Social Security number, two Illinois residency documents, and a signature-verification document.
REAL ID applications are made in person at an Illinois DMV or eligible REAL ID facility.
Original hard-copy identity documents are required; printed electronic residency documents can be accepted.

A REAL ID is not required to drive, vote, or receive state/federal services; another federally accepted ID such as a valid U.S. passport can satisfy federal identification requirements where applicable.
